newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Omico to operate an investment house.
newsitem.headline: Omico to operate an investment house.

text.p: Omico Corp said on Tuesday it is opening an investment house which will design securities to finance real estate development projects.

"It will serve as the vehicle for executing the extensive mandates that Omico has received from various entities to provide them with financial engineering and securities origination services, as an integral part of their property development projects," Omico told the Philippine Stock Exchange.
It said most of the mandates are to design and package municipal and provincial bonds for a number of local government units.

"The formation of the investment house will permit Omico to expand its financial engineering product beyond the provision of consultancy services in securities design and origination, and to include underwriting, secondary dealership, corporate finance and treasury operations, among others," it added.
